# Retained work-report inputs

`a105-parent-input-too-large.json.gz` retains the complete original A105 parent
bootstrap frame and reconstructed fields, original instructions, actual
transmitted text and exact recorded rejection from provider session1471 at root
decision59 of `a105_full_verification_20261107_01`. The input contains1,052,431
characters and all30 admitted historical child forms. Current sheet custody
contains16 main-sheet heads from distinct owner uses and10 unique subscoring
sheets; the fixture preserves all of them. It also retains the six received
typed source findings, including the explicit replacement qualification of the
ChEMBL finding. Original file paths and SHA256 digests are included; the fixture
does not sample, trim or reconstruct scientific values. The original report
found two native physical measurements but did not complete full scientific
validation. Its replay checks actual provider presentation without starting a
model or changing the saved frame, evidence, grades or original credit.

`a105-parent-completed-work-receipts.json.gz` retains the matching original
parent's31 action rows,31 completion observations and30 child-return attempts,
with their exact table schemas and source-database digest. It contains no child
private action history. The replay restores those parent-owned receipts in a
read-only in-memory SQLite connection and runs the current completed-work
projector. Only that presentation field is refreshed before reconstructing the
parent prompt; original scientific fields, saved grades and credit receipts
remain unchanged. Both fixtures are required regression inputs, rather than
disposable run output.

`a11038-source-navigation.json.gz` preserves the original A11038 navigation
context and its actual provider rejection. Its replay checks that reading a
source does not expand an already admitted native result into every history row.

`a107-genomic02-revised-selection.json.gz` preserves the actual A107 genomic02
follow-up input at decision334, provider session0454. The provider rejected
1,051,732 characters against its 1,048,576-character interface. The preceding
`process.revise` returned a full pinned child selection, including repeated tool
instructions. The fixture retains the complete supplied state, original wire
text, original last-outcome view and recorded failure. The workload was stopped
and drained before the presentation repair. Its admitted partial report is not
a normal autonomous completion.

The recorded provider capacities are interface evidence for these regressions;
they are not application settings, scientific stopping budgets or truncation
rules. Replays do not start a model, native algorithm or remote job.

`a107-genomic06-resource-context.json.gz` retains the actual initial root frame,
instructions and transmitted text from genomic06. The host context contained
